findings.title: Findings converge on D1-A's inference of "connectivity" from last_update_success
findings.why_it_matters: off conflates unreachable with reachable-but-failing polls before D4 locks the device class
findings.recommended: A: Re-evaluate D1-A's inference before addressing Findings 2 and 5
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate D1-A's inference before addressing Findings 2 and 5
findings.choice_reason: Settled on CONNECTIVITY plus a reason attribute from the existing translation key; frozen-at-first-failure accepted

findings.title: "Disconnected" is shown for failures where hassette is reachable
findings.why_it_matters: 401/403/redirect/unreadable/unsupported-version show as Disconnected with no cause
findings.recommended: A: Add a short reason attribute while off

findings.title: Setup-retry backoff can hold the sensor unavailable for up to 10 minutes after hassette is back
findings.why_it_matters: D2 ratified on the state label, not the recovery latency
findings.recommended: A: Add the backoff and its 10-minute bound to D2's accepting clause and the README's Known limitations, with a manual entry reload as the workaround
findings.chosen: A: Add the backoff and its 10-minute bound to D2's accepting clause and the README's Known limitations, with a manual entry reload as the workaround

findings.title: The documented not_to: "on" recipe fires on every reload and misses an HA restart mid-outage
findings.why_it_matters: D2's rationale rested on a recipe that misfires
findings.recommended: A: Change D2's rationale and the README recipe to to: ["off", "unavailable"] with a for: longer than a reload, plus an HA-start trigger with a state condition
findings.chosen: Drop the recipe entirely; README only states what off and unavailable mean
findings.choice_reason: hassette users write automations in Python; documenting HA automation recipes is backwards

findings.title: The add-on follow path reports a self-healing token or port change as an outage
findings.why_it_matters: on/off/unavailable/on flap while hassette was answering
findings.recommended: A: Accept the brief off flap, and document for: as the recommended guard

findings.title: Detection latency and tolerated-poll staleness contradict D5
findings.why_it_matters: D5's absolute wording conflicts with D1's bounded staleness

findings.title: The headline entity reads "Connected" while every app is unavailable
findings.why_it_matters: held bootstrap is invisible on default dashboards
findings.chosen: Side A: Keep D3/D4, one README line

findings.title: Entity id binary_sensor.hassette is not guaranteed if the id is already taken
findings.why_it_matters: README examples could name the wrong id
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: a pre-existing binary_sensor.hassette makes this entity binary_sensor.hassette_2
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: a pre-existing binary_sensor.hassette makes this entity binary_sensor.hassette_2
